description.value: Taka Japanese Restaurant is a locally beloved spot in Kamloops specializing in fresh handcrafted Japanese cuisine, most famous for its Oshi Sushi — a pressed or box-style sushi unique to the menu. The restaurant combines traditional Japanese flavours with Western influences, offering an extensive menu of sushi rolls, teriyaki, ramen, tempura, and bento boxes. Alcohol is served on premises, vegan options are available, and delivery is offered through UberEats, Skip the Dishes, and DoorDash, making it convenient for cyclists who may prefer to order ahead.
